**Five services are affected within two hops** of a retry-semantics change to **NotificationsAPI**.

| Hop | Affected service | Dependency path |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **BillingService** | Calls **NotificationsAPI** directly. |
| 1 | **PaymentsService** | Calls **NotificationsAPI** directly. |
| 2 | **RenewalsWorker** | Depends on **BillingService**, which calls **NotificationsAPI**. |
| 2 | **ReportingService** | Depends on **BillingService**, which calls **NotificationsAPI**. |
| 2 | **OrderService** | Calls **PaymentsAPI**, exposed by **PaymentsService**, which calls **NotificationsAPI**. |

The count treats **PaymentsService** and its exposed **PaymentsAPI** as one place. No databases or configuration keys appear in these dependency paths.
